literal: Conquering is necessary of the five the sensory domain; renouncing is necessary desired things all together.
translation: One must conquer the domain of the five senses, and simultaneously renounce all desired things of the world.
modern: ஐந்து புலன்களின் வழியே செல்லும் ஆசையை வெல்ல வேண்டும்; விரும்பிய அனைத்தையும் ஒரே நேரத்தில் துறக்க வேண்டும்.
explanation: This couplet outlines the essential steps for true renunciation. The 'five' refers to the five senses, and 'pulam' represents their respective domains of desire. To succeed in asceticism, one must first conquer these sensory impulses. Along with this internal control, one must completely and simultaneously abandon all external attachments and desires. The poet emphasizes that both sensory mastery and the giving up of worldly desires must happen together for complete liberation.
